name: Pozole
description: Hot and ready, pork, chicken, or vegan. Toppings and salsas added by you at the table.
fulfillmentNote: Hot and assembled fresh at the market or trailer, this version can't be delivered or picked up cold. For a frozen quart to take home, see Take Home Pozole.
longDescription: Our family's original White Pozole recipe, from Mexico City, made with pork, chicken, or vegan jackfruit. Hominy simmered low in broth, served hot in a cup at the market or a bowl at home, and finished by you at the table, not by us. Red style is built on guajillo chiles, Green on tomatillos and serrano peppers. Every order gets the same topping spread: cabbage, radishes, onions, jalapenos, cilantro, oregano, red pepper flakes, limes, and avocado, so the heat and the crunch are entirely up to you.
